verses.original: וַֽיִּגְּשׁוּ֙ כָּל־ שָׂרֵ֣י הַחֲיָלִ֔ים וְיֽוֹחָנָן֙ בֶּן־ קָרֵ֔חַ וִֽיזַנְיָ֖ה בֶּן־ הוֹשַֽׁעְיָ֑ה וְכָל־ הָעָ֖ם מִקָּטֹ֥ן וְעַד־ גָּדֽוֹל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yig·gə·šū kāl- śā·rê ha·ḥă·yā·lîm wə·yō·w·ḥā·nān ben- qā·rê·aḥ wî·zan·yāh ben- hō·wō·ša‘·yāh wə·ḵāl hā·‘ām miq·qā·ṭōn wə·‘aḏ- gā·ḏō·wl
verses.literal: Then all the commanders of the forces along with Johanan son of Kareah Jezaniah son of Hoshaiah and all the people from the least to the greatest approached
verses.literalPt: ENTÃO chegaram todos os capitães dos exércitos, e Joanã, filho de Careá, e Jezanias, filho de Hosaías, e todo o povo, desde o menor até ao maior,

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֞וּ אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֣הוּ הַנָּבִ֗יא תִּפָּל־ נָ֤א תְחִנָּתֵ֙נוּ֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ וְהִתְפַּלֵּ֤ל בַּעֲדֵ֙נוּ֙ אֶל־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בְּעַ֖ד כָּל־ הַשְּׁאֵרִ֣ית הַזֹּ֑את כִּֽי־ נִשְׁאַ֤רְנוּ מְעַט֙ מֵֽהַרְבֵּ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עֵינֶ֖יךָ רֹא֥וֹת אֹתָֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’el- yir·mə·yā·hū han·nā·ḇî tip·pāl- nā ṯə·ḥin·nā·ṯê·nū lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā wə·hiṯ·pal·lêl ba·‘ă·ḏê·nū ’el- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā bə·‘aḏ kāl- haš·šə·’ê·rîṯ haz·zōṯ kî- niš·’ar·nū mə·‘aṭ mê·har·bêh ka·’ă·šer ‘ê·ne·ḵā rō·’ō·wṯ ’ō·ṯā·nū
verses.literal: Jeremiah the prophet and said May our petition come . . . before you pray . . . to the LORD your God on behalf of this entire remnant For few of us remain of the many as you can see with your own eyes
verses.literalPt: E disseram a Jeremias, o profeta: Aceita agora a nossa súplica diante de ti, e roga ao SENHOR teu Deus, por nós e por todo este remanescente; porque de muitos restamos uns poucos, como nos vêem os teus olhos;

verses.original: וְיַגֶּד־ לָ֙נוּ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ אֶת־ הַדֶּ֖רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נֵֽלֶךְ־ בָּ֑הּ וְאֶת־ הַדָּבָ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר נַעֲשֶֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yag·geḏ- lā·nū Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’eṯ- had·de·reḵ ’ă·šer nê·leḵ- bāh wə·’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer na·‘ă·śeh
verses.literal: Pray that the LORD your God will tell us the way we should walk and the thing we should do
verses.literalPt: Para que o SENHOR teu Deus nos ensine o caminho por onde havemos de andar e aquilo que havemos de fazer.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֜ם יִרְמְיָ֤הוּ הַנָּבִיא֙ שָׁמַ֔עְתִּי הִנְנִ֧י מִתְפַּלֵּ֛ל אֶל־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם כְּדִבְרֵיכֶ֑ם וְֽהָיָ֡ה כָּֽל־ הַדָּבָר֩ אֲשֶׁר־ יַעֲנֶ֨ה יְהוָ֤ה אֶתְכֶם֙ אַגִּ֣יד לָכֶ֔ם לֹֽא־ אֶמְנַ֥ע מִכֶּ֖ם דָּבָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem yir·mə·yā·hū han·nā·ḇî šā·ma‘·tî hin·nî miṯ·pal·lêl ’el- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem kə·ḏiḇ·rê·ḵem wə·hā·yāh kāl- had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer- ya·‘ă·neh Yah·weh ’eṯ·ḵem ’ag·gîḏ lā·ḵem lō- ’em·na‘ mik·kem dā·ḇār
verses.literal: I have heard you replied Jeremiah the prophet I will surely pray to the LORD your God as you request . . . and I will tell you everything . . . that the LORD answers I will not withhold a word from you
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhes Jeremias, o profeta: Eu vos tenho ouvido; eis que orarei ao SENHOR vosso Deus conforme as vossas palavras; e seja o que for que o SENHOR vos responder eu vo-lo declararei; não vos ocultarei uma só palavra.

verses.original: וְהֵ֙מָּה֙ אָמְר֣וּ אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ יְהִ֤י יְהוָה֙ בָּ֔נוּ לְעֵ֖ד אֱמֶ֣ת וְנֶאֱמָ֑ן אִם־ לֹ֡א כְּֽכָל־ הַ֠דָּבָר אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִֽשְׁלָחֲךָ֜ יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ אֵלֵ֖ינוּ כֵּ֥ן נַעֲשֶֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hêm·māh ’ā·mə·rū ’el- yir·mə·yā·hū yə·hî Yah·weh bā·nū lə·‘êḏ ’ĕ·meṯ wə·ne·’ĕ·mān ’im- lō kə·ḵāl- had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer yiš·lā·ḥă·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’ê·lê·nū kên na·‘ă·śeh
verses.literal: Then they said to Jeremiah May the LORD be a true and faithful witness against us if we do not act upon every word that the LORD your God sends you to tell us
verses.literalPt: Então eles disseram a Jeremias: Seja o SENHOR entre nós testemunha verdadeira e fiel, se não fizermos conforme toda a palavra com que te enviar a nós o SENHOR teu Deus.

verses.original: אִם־ ט֣וֹב וְאִם־ רָ֔ע בְּק֣וֹל׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲנוּ שֹׁלְחִ֥ים אֹתְךָ֛ אֵלָ֖יו נִשְׁמָ֑ע לְמַ֙עַן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִֽיטַב־ לָ֔נוּ כִּ֣י נִשְׁמַ֔ע בְּק֖וֹל יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’im- ṭō·wḇ wə·’im- rā‘ bə·qō·wl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū ’ă·šer ʾă·nū šō·lə·ḥîm ’ō·ṯə·ḵā ’ê·lāw niš·mā‘ lə·ma·‘an ’ă·šer yî·ṭaḇ- lā·nū kî niš·ma‘ bə·qō·wl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū
verses.literal: Whether it is pleasant or unpleasant we will obey the voice of the LORD our God to whom we are sending you so that it may go well with us when we obey the voice of the LORD our God
verses.literalPt: Seja ela boa, ou seja má, à voz do SENHOR nosso Deus, a quem te enviamos, obedeceremos, para que nos suceda bem, obedecendo à voz do SENHOR nosso Deus.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֕י מִקֵּ֖ץ עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת יָמִ֑ים וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî miq·qêṣ ‘ă·śe·reṯ yā·mîm way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’el- yir·mə·yā·hū
verses.literal: After ten days . . . the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que ao fim de dez dias veio a palavra do SENHOR a Jeremias.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֗א אֶל־ יֽוֹחָנָן֙ בֶּן־ קָרֵ֔חַ וְאֶ֛ל כָּל־ שָׂרֵ֥י הַחֲיָלִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֑וֹ וּלְכָ֨ל־ הָעָ֔ם לְמִקָּטֹ֥ן וְעַד־ גָּדֽוֹל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā ’el- yō·w·ḥā·nān ben- qā·rê·aḥ wə·’el kāl- śā·rê ha·ḥă·yā·lîm ’ă·šer ’it·tōw ū·lə·ḵāl- hā·‘ām lə·miq·qā·ṭōn wə·‘aḏ- gā·ḏō·wl
verses.literal: and he summoned . . . Johanan son of Kareah . . . all the commanders of the forces who were with him and all the people from the least to the greatest
verses.literalPt: Então chamou a Joanã, filho de Careá, e a todos os capitães dos exércitos, que havia com ele, e a todo o povo, desde o menor até ao maior,

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר שְׁלַחְתֶּ֤ם אֹתִי֙ אֵלָ֔יו לְהַפִּ֥יל תְּחִנַּתְכֶ֖ם לְפָנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer šə·laḥ·tem ’ō·ṯî ’ê·lāw lə·hap·pîl tə·ḥin·naṯ·ḵem lə·p̄ā·nāw
verses.literal: Jeremiah told them Thus says the LORD the God of Israel to whom you sent me to present your petition
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhes: Assim diz o SENHOR, Deus de Israel, a quem me enviastes, para apresentar a vossa súplica diante dele:

verses.original: אִם־ שׁ֤וֹב תֵּֽשְׁבוּ֙ בָּאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את וּבָנִ֤יתִי אֶתְכֶם֙ וְלֹ֣א אֶהֱרֹ֔ס וְנָטַעְתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם וְלֹ֣א אֶתּ֑וֹשׁ כִּ֤י נִחַ֙מְתִּי֙ אֶל־ הָ֣רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֖יתִי לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- šō·wḇ tê·šə·ḇū bā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ ū·ḇā·nî·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem wə·lō ’e·hĕ·rōs wə·nā·ṭa‘·tî ’eṯ·ḵem wə·lō ’et·tō·wōš kî ni·ḥam·tî ’el- hā·rā·‘āh ’ă·šer ‘ā·śî·ṯî lā·ḵem
verses.literal: If . . . you will indeed stay in this land then I will build you up and not tear you down I will plant you and not uproot you for I will relent of the disaster I have brought upon you
verses.literalPt: Se de boa mente ficardes nesta terra, então vos edificarei, e não vos derrubarei; e vos plantarei, e não vos arrancarei; porque estou arrependido do mal que vos tenho feito.

verses.original: אַל־ תִּֽירְא֗וּ מִפְּנֵי֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל אֲשֶׁר־ אַתֶּ֥ם יְרֵאִ֖ים מִפָּנָ֑יו אַל־ תִּֽירְא֤וּ מִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה כִּֽי־ אִתְּכֶ֣ם אָ֔נִי לְהוֹשִׁ֧יעַ אֶתְכֶ֛ם וּלְהַצִּ֥יל אֶתְכֶ֖ם מִיָּדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tî·rə·’ū mip·pə·nê me·leḵ bā·ḇel ’ă·šer- ’at·tem yə·rê·’îm mip·pā·nāw ’al- tî·rə·’ū mim·men·nū nə·’um- Yah·weh kî- ’it·tə·ḵem ’ā·nî lə·hō·wō·šî·a‘ ’eṯ·ḵem ū·lə·haṣ·ṣîl ’eṯ·ḵem mî·yā·ḏōw
verses.literal: Do not be afraid of the king of Babylon whom you now fear do not be afraid of him declares the LORD for I am with you to save you and deliver you from him
verses.literalPt: Não temais o rei de Babilônia, a quem vós temeis; não o temais, diz o SENHOR, porque eu sou convosco, para vos salvar e para vos livrar da sua mão.

verses.original: וְאֶתֵּ֥ן לָכֶ֛ם רַחֲמִ֖ים וְרִחַ֣ם אֶתְכֶ֑ם וְהֵשִׁ֥יב אֶתְכֶ֖ם אֶל־ אַדְמַתְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’et·tên lā·ḵem ra·ḥă·mîm wə·ri·ḥam ’eṯ·ḵem wə·hê·šîḇ ’eṯ·ḵem ’el- ’aḏ·maṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: And I will show you compassion and he will have compassion on you and restore you to your own land
verses.literalPt: E vos concederei misericórdia, para que ele tenha misericórdia de vós, e vos faça voltar à vossa terra.

verses.original: וְאִם־ אֹמְרִ֣ים אַתֶּ֔ם לֹ֥א נֵשֵׁ֖ב בָּאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֑את לְבִלְתִּ֣י שְׁמֹ֔עַ בְּק֖וֹל יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- ’ō·mə·rîm ’at·tem lō nê·šêḇ bā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ lə·ḇil·tî šə·mō·a‘ bə·qō·wl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: But if you say We will not stay in this land and you thus disobey the voice of the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: Mas se vós disserdes: Não ficaremos nesta terra, não obedecendo à voz do SENHOR vosso Deus,

verses.original: לֵאמֹ֗ר לֹ֚א כִּ֣י אֶ֤רֶץ מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ נָב֔וֹא אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־ נִרְאֶה֙ מִלְחָמָ֔ה וְק֥וֹל שׁוֹפָ֖ר לֹ֣א נִשְׁמָ֑ע וְלַלֶּ֥חֶם לֹֽא־ נִרְעָ֖ב וְשָׁ֥ם נֵשֵֽׁב׃
verses.transliteration: lê·mōr lō kî ’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim nā·ḇō·w ’ă·šer lō- nir·’eh mil·ḥā·māh wə·qō·wl šō·w·p̄ār lō niš·mā‘ wə·lal·le·ḥem lō- nir·‘āḇ wə·šām nê·šêḇ
verses.literal: and if you say No but we will go to the land of Egypt and live there where we will not see war or hear the sound of the ram’s horn . . . . . . or hunger for bread
verses.literalPt: Dizendo: Não, antes iremos à terra do Egito, onde não veremos guerra, nem ouviremos som de trombeta, nem teremos fome de pão, e ali ficaremos,

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה לָכֵ֛ן שִׁמְע֥וּ דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יְהוּדָ֑ה כֹּֽה־ אָמַר֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אִם־ אַ֠תֶּם שׂ֣וֹם תְּשִׂמ֤וּן פְּנֵיכֶם֙ לָבֹ֣א מִצְרַ֔יִם וּבָאתֶ֖ם לָג֥וּר שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh lā·ḵên šim·‘ū ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh šə·’ê·rîṯ yə·hū·ḏāh kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ’im- ’at·tem śō·wm tə·śi·mūn pə·nê·ḵem lā·ḇō miṣ·ra·yim ū·ḇā·ṯem lā·ḡūr šām
verses.literal: then . . . hear the word of the LORD O remnant of Judah This is what the LORD of Hosts the God of Israel says If you are determined . . . . . . to go to Egypt . . . and reside there
verses.literalPt: Nesse caso ouvi a palavra do SENHOR, ó remanescente de Judá: Assim diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos, Deus de Israel: Se vós absolutamente propuserdes a entrar no Egito, e entrardes para lá habitar,

verses.original: וְהָיְתָ֣ה הַחֶ֗רֶב אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתֶּם֙ יְרֵאִ֣ים מִמֶּ֔נָּה שָׁ֛ם תַּשִּׂ֥יג אֶתְכֶ֖ם בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְהָרָעָ֞ב אֲשֶׁר־ אַתֶּ֣ם׀ דֹּאֲגִ֣ים מִמֶּ֗נּוּ שָׁ֣ם יִדְבַּ֧ק אַחֲרֵיכֶ֛ם מִצְרַ֖יִם וְשָׁ֥ם תָּמֻֽתוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yə·ṯāh ha·ḥe·reḇ ’ă·šer ’at·tem yə·rê·’îm mim·men·nāh šām taś·śîḡ ’eṯ·ḵem bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim wə·hā·rā·‘āḇ ’ă·šer- ’at·tem dō·’ă·ḡîm mim·men·nū šām yiḏ·baq ’a·ḥă·rê·ḵem miṣ·ra·yim wə·šām tā·mu·ṯū
verses.literal: then the sword you fear will overtake you there - and the famine you dread . . . will follow on your heels . . . into Egypt and you will die there
verses.literalPt: Acontecerá que a espada que vós temeis vos alcançará ali na terra do Egito, e a fome que vós receais vos seguirá de perto no Egito, e ali morrereis.

verses.original: וְיִֽהְי֣וּ כָל־ הָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים אֲשֶׁר־ שָׂ֨מוּ אֶת־ פְּנֵיהֶ֜ם לָב֤וֹא מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ לָג֣וּר שָׁ֔ם יָמ֕וּתוּ בַּחֶ֖רֶב בָּרָעָ֣ב וּבַדָּ֑בֶר וְלֹֽא־ יִהְיֶ֤ה לָהֶם֙ שָׂרִ֣יד וּפָלִ֔יט מִפְּנֵי֙ הָֽרָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י מֵבִ֥יא עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·yih·yū ḵāl hā·’ă·nā·šîm ’ă·šer- śā·mū ’eṯ- pə·nê·hem lā·ḇō·w miṣ·ra·yim lā·ḡūr šām yā·mū·ṯū ba·ḥe·reḇ bā·rā·‘āḇ ū·ḇad·dā·ḇer wə·lō- yih·yeh lā·hem śā·rîḏ ū·p̄ā·lîṭ mip·pə·nê hā·rā·‘āh ’ă·šer ’ă·nî mê·ḇî ‘ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: So all . . . who resolve - to go to Egypt to reside there will die by sword and famine and plague Not one of them will survive or escape . . . the disaster I will bring upon them
verses.literalPt: Assim será com todos os homens que puseram os seus rostos para entrarem no Egito, a fim de lá habitarem: morrerão à espada, e de fome, e de peste; e deles não haverá quem reste e escape do mal que eu farei vir sobre eles.

verses.original: כִּי֩ כֹ֨ה אָמַ֜ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָאוֹת֮ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ נִתַּ֨ךְ אַפִּ֜י וַחֲמָתִ֗י עַל־ יֹֽשְׁבֵי֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם כֵּ֣ן תִּתַּ֤ךְ חֲמָתִי֙ עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם בְּבֹאֲכֶ֖ם מִצְרָ֑יִם וִהְיִיתֶ֞ם לְאָלָ֤ה וּלְשַׁמָּה֙ וְלִקְלָלָ֣ה וּלְחֶרְפָּ֔ה וְלֹֽא־ תִרְא֣וּ ע֔וֹד אֶת־ הַמָּק֖וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ka·’ă·šer nit·taḵ ’ap·pî wa·ḥă·mā·ṯî ‘al- yō·šə·ḇê yə·rū·šā·lim kên tit·taḵ ḥă·mā·ṯî ‘ă·lê·ḵem bə·ḇō·’ă·ḵem miṣ·rā·yim wih·yî·ṯem lə·’ā·lāh ū·lə·šam·māh wə·liq·lā·lāh ū·lə·ḥer·pāh wə·lō- ṯir·’ū ‘ō·wḏ ’eṯ- ham·mā·qō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: For this is what the LORD of Hosts the God of Israel says Just as My anger and wrath were poured out on the residents of Jerusalem so will My wrath be poured out on you if you go to Egypt You will become an object of cursing and horror of vilification and disgrace and you will never see this place again
verses.literalPt: Porque assim diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos, Deus de Israel: Como se derramou a minha ira e a minha indignação sobre os habitantes de Jerusalém, assim se derramará a minha indignação sobre vós, quando entrardes no Egito; e sereis objeto de maldição, e de espanto, e de execração, e de opróbrio, e não vereis mais este lugar.

verses.original: דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהוָ֤ה עֲלֵיכֶם֙ שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יְהוּדָ֔ה אַל־ תָּבֹ֖אוּ מִצְרָ֑יִם יָדֹ֙עַ֙ תֵּֽדְע֔וּ כִּי־ הַעִידֹ֥תִי בָכֶ֖ם הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: dib·ber Yah·weh ‘ă·lê·ḵem šə·’ê·rîṯ yə·hū·ḏāh ’al- tā·ḇō·’ū miṣ·rā·yim yā·ḏō·a‘ tê·ḏə·‘ū kî- ha·‘î·ḏō·ṯî ḇā·ḵem hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: The LORD has told you O remnant of Judah Do not go to Egypt Know for sure . . . that I have warned you today
verses.literalPt: Falou o SENHOR acerca de vós, ó remanescente de Judá! Não entreis no Egito; tende por certo que hoje testifiquei contra vós.

verses.original: כִּ֣י הִתְעֵתֶים בְּנַפְשֽׁוֹתֵיכֶם֒ כִּֽי־ אַתֶּ֞ם שְׁלַחְתֶּ֣ם אֹתִ֗י אֶל־ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הִתְפַּלֵּ֣ל בַּעֲדֵ֔נוּ אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וּכְכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יֹאמַ֜ר יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵ֛ינוּ כֵּ֥ן הַגֶּד־ לָ֖נוּ וְעָשִֽׂינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî hiṯ·ʿē·ṯɛm bə·nap̄·šō·w·ṯê·ḵem kî- ’at·tem šə·laḥ·tem ’ō·ṯî ’el- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem lê·mōr hiṯ·pal·lêl ba·‘ă·ḏê·nū ’el- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū ū·ḵə·ḵōl ’ă·šer yō·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū kên hag·geḏ- lā·nū wə·‘ā·śî·nū
verses.literal: For you . . . have deceived yourselves by sending me to the LORD your God saying Pray to the LORD our God on our behalf and as for all that the LORD our God . . . says tell it to us and we will do it
verses.literalPt: Porque vos enganastes a vós mesmos, pois me enviastes ao SENHOR vosso Deus, dizendo: Ora por nós ao SENHOR nosso Deus; e conforme tudo o que disser o SENHOR nosso Deus, declara-no-lo assim, e o faremos.

verses.original: וָאַגִּ֥ד לָכֶ֖ם הַיּ֑וֹם וְלֹ֣א שְׁמַעְתֶּ֗ם בְּקוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם וּלְכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁר־ שְׁלָחַ֥נִי אֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ag·giḏ lā·ḵem hay·yō·wm wə·lō šə·ma‘·tem bə·qō·wl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem ū·lə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- šə·lā·ḥa·nî ’ă·lê·ḵem
verses.literal: For I have told you today but you have not obeyed the voice of the LORD your God in all He has sent me to tell you
verses.literalPt: E vo-lo tenho declarado hoje; mas não destes ouvidos à voz do SENHOR vosso Deus, em coisa alguma pela qual ele me enviou a vós.

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ יָדֹ֣עַ תֵּֽדְע֔וּ כִּ֗י בַּחֶ֛רֶב בָּרָעָ֥ב וּבַדֶּ֖בֶר תָּמ֑וּתוּ בַּמָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חֲפַצְתֶּ֔ם לָב֖וֹא לָג֥וּר שָֽׁם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh yā·ḏō·a‘ tê·ḏə·‘ū kî ba·ḥe·reḇ bā·rā·‘āḇ ū·ḇad·de·ḇer tā·mū·ṯū bam·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer ḥă·p̄aṣ·tem lā·ḇō·w lā·ḡūr šām
verses.literal: Now therefore know for sure that by sword and famine and plague you will die in the place where you desire to go to reside . . .
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, sabei por certo que morrereis à espada, de fome e de peste no mesmo lugar onde desejais ir, para lá morardes.
